## About

I am Assoc. Prof. PD. Dr. techn. habil. **Fadi Al Machot**, specializing in Zero/Few-Shot Learning, Explainable AI, Temporal Data Analysis, and Neural-Symbolic Learning with Knowledge Representation. My research translates into impactful applications in healthcare and assisted living, automotive and ADAS, smart agriculture, and bioinformatics — developing lightweight and context-aware AI solutions that bridge logic, learning, and real-world needs.


<div style="background:#e8f1fb;border:1px solid #b8d4f0;border-radius:8px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;margin:1rem 0;">
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6rem;margin-bottom:0.4rem;">
<span style="font-size:1.1rem;">🔬</span>
<strong style="color:#1a3a5c;font-size:0.95rem;">Research Group Leader — TETRA AI</strong>
</div>
<p style="font-size:0.88rem;margin:0;color:#1a3a5c;line-height:1.6;">
<a href="https://www.nmbu.no/en/research/groups/tetra-ai" target="_blank" style="font-weight:600;color:#1a3a5c;">Trustworthy and Efficient Transfer Learning AI (TETRA AI)</a> — a research group at NMBU dedicated to advancing methods that make AI models both trustworthy and highly efficient. Research focuses on zero/few-shot learning, neural-symbolic reasoning, and lightweight architectures for real-world deployment.
</p>
</div>

> **Patent** &middot; European Research Patent No. EP2790165 — *Quality Determination in Data Acquisition* (2013), in collaboration with Swarco Traffic Systems, Germany.

const CATS = {all:'All',paper:'Paper',grant:'Grant & Project',role:'PC / Role',award:'Award',talk:'Talk'};
const CBADGE = {
  paper:'background:#e8f1fb;color:#0c447c',
  grant:'background:#eaf3de;color:#27500a',
  role:'background:#EEEDFE;color:#3C3489',
  award:'background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806',
  talk:'background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041'
};
const CLABEL = {paper:'Paper',grant:'Grant',role:'Role',award:'Award',talk:'Talk'};

let activeCat = 'all';
let showAll = false;

function renderNews() {
  const filtered = NEWS.filter(n => activeCat === 'all' || n.cat === activeCat);
  const visible = showAll ? filtered : filtered.slice(0, 6);

  let filterHTML = Object.entries(CATS).map(([k,v]) => {
    const active = activeCat === k;
    const style = active
      ? 'background:#1a3a5c;color:white;border-color:#1a3a5c;'
      : 'background:white;color:#6c757d;border-color:#dde4ed;';
    return `<span onclick="setNewsCat('${k}')" style="font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid;cursor:pointer;${style}">${v}</span>`;
  }).join('');

  let itemsHTML = visible.map(n => {
    const badge = `<span style="font-size:9px;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;margin-right:5px;${CBADGE[n.cat]}">${CLABEL[n.cat]}</span>`;
    return `<div style="border-left:3px solid #2d7dd2;padding:0.5rem 0 0.5rem 0.8rem;margin-bottom:0.8rem;">
      <div style="font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#6c757d;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:2px;">${n.d}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.88rem;line-height:1.5;">${badge}${n.t}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const toggleBtn = filtered.length > 6
    ? `<button onclick="toggleAllNews()" style="font-size:12px;color:#6c757d;background:none;border:1px solid #dde4ed;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 12px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:4px;">
        ${showAll ? 'Show less ▴' : `Show all ${filtered.length} ▾`}
      </button>` : '';

  document.getElementById('news-app').innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-bottom:12px;">${filterHTML}</div>
    ${itemsHTML}
    ${toggleBtn}
  `;
}

function setNewsCat(cat) {
  activeCat = cat;
  showAll = false;
  renderNews();
}

function toggleAllNews() {
  showAll = !showAll;
  renderNews();
}

renderNews();
</script>

  })

</script>
